newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador trade deficit falls to $328.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador trade deficit falls to $328.6 mln.

text.p: El Salvador's trade deficit fell to $328.6 million in the first four months of 1997, compared with a shortfall of $411.8 million in the same period the year before, the central bank said on Tuesday.

According to a report from the Central American nation's central bank, exports grew to $837.7 million, an increase of 33 percent compared to $630.5 million in the year-ago period. Coffee exports led the increase, boosted by the recent rise in world coffee prices.
Imports also rose to $1.166 billion, a rise of 11.9 percent from the $1.042 billion imported from January to April in 1996.
El Salvador's gross domestic product grew three percent in 1996 and inflation was 7.4 percent for the year.
